description: Lists everyone on the account: how they sign in, the rank they hold, and how far they see into the mail. An owner and a manager work every helpdesk queue, which is said as works_every_queue; anyone else works the queues named on them and nothing else. It says who works where, never what any of it holds. A rank is not written from here: for a client of Simafri Suite it is held at the shop and restated at every sign-in.
name: list_people
title: List the people of the account
